Phomymo portions used by Filament DB

Origin: https://github.com/transcriptionstream/phomymo
Pinned commit: 1f58d3f0e7f941b9143277cda828380149e56855
Attribution: transcriptionstream and the Phomymo contributors.

License basis: upstream README declares MIT; the Filament DB project owner
confirmed MIT for this integration. At the pinned commit, no root LICENSE file
is present and package.json separately declares ISC. This discrepancy is
recorded here rather than presenting a fabricated upstream LICENSE file or
copyright year. The inspected source portions contain no copyright header.
Filament DB's own repository license remains unchanged.

Adapted portions:
- src/web/printer.js: densityToHeatTime, M-series CMD, printBLE and printUSB;
  kept command bytes, order, chunk sizes and pacing; removed logging and other
  model protocols. Used in ../printer-protocol-m220.js.
- src/web/canvas.js: text rendering/wrapping/auto-sizing, RGBA-to-grayscale,
  Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson and ordered dithering. Used in ../label-renderer.js
  and ../label-raster.js. Removed editor state, external libraries, caches and
  global UI dependencies. Added validation, binary endpoint preservation,
  QR protection and pixel-exact right-aligned packing.
- src/web/ble.js and src/web/usb.js: GATT characteristic selection and USB
  open/claim/OUT transfer structure, adapted in ../printer-bluetooth.js and
  ../printer-usb.js. Removed singletons, automatic reconnect, chooser retries,
  write fallback/replay, status queries, unrelated models and broad discovery.
  Added cancellation, explicit capability checks and USB alternate/interface
  selection by descriptors rather than interface-array indexes.
- src/web/printers.json and src/web/constants.js: M220 facts, service/write
  identifiers and defaults, represented in ../printer-definitions.js and
  ../print-jobs.js. No complete upstream application is bundled.

The two design reference JSON files were supplied by the Filament DB project
owner and used to verify initial Phomymo v3 import compatibility. The example
files and obsolete embedded example layout were subsequently removed at the
owner's request. Native labels now share the existing SVG labels' layout,
material band and Bambu Lab wordmark. That logo retains its separate CC BY-SA
4.0 attribution in vendor/bambu-lab-logo.js and its embedded image metadata.
Synthetic supported-element designs cover JSON compatibility in tests.

Full graphical designer integration
-----------------------------------
The embedded designer additionally vendors app.js, canvas.js, elements.js,
handles.js, constants.js, templates.js, storage.js, utils/bindings.js,
utils/errors.js, utils/validation.js and the index.html interface from the
same pinned upstream commit. Upstream interface strings remain vendor text.

Adaptations: removed external fonts/CDN runtime dependencies, precompiled the
Tailwind 3.4.17 styles, applied a Dracula integration stylesheet, isolated the
designer in an opaque-origin sandbox, provided ephemeral settings storage,
replaced hardware transports with disabled adapters, removed printer commands,
and added a strict host/document message bridge. Template database storage and
physical printing belong to Filament DB; dataset/multi-label/printer management
workflows are hidden. Supported label sizes are controlled by the host. PDF
imports rasterize the first page using the locally bundled PDF.js.

Locally bundled dependencies (upstream pins):
- JsBarcode 3.11.5: MIT, Johan Lindell; includes the private host ES module
  wrapper ../barcode.js. https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode/tree/v3.11.5
- node-qrcode 1.5.1: MIT, Ryan Day;
  https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode/tree/v1.5.1
- jsPDF 2.5.1: MIT, James Hall, yWorks GmbH and contributors;
  https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF/tree/v2.5.1
- PDF.js 4.0.379: Apache-2.0, Mozilla Foundation;
  https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/v4.0.379
- Tailwind CSS 3.4.17: MIT, Tailwind Labs; compiled CSS is checked in,
  no runtime compiler or build step is required.
  https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/tree/v3.4.17

Dependency license texts follow. Existing license banners in vendor files
are retained.
